title: Each native test entry crosses a fresh process boundary
observed_need: Run a suite and its entries while preserving one compiler/runtime session, shared provenance, and bounded setup state.
current_language_behavior: The external execution ABI is one JSON request to one mncs process; it has no stable in-process call or batch-suite session for a consumer.
why_insufficient: The current runner executes the suite and then each entry independently, adding compile/startup cost and preventing native fixture/session ownership.
minimal_reproducer: A six-entry mncs-test-self run produces one suite execute plus six entry execute subprocesses in .mncs/mncs-test-artifacts/commands/.
desired_direction: A versioned batch/session execution API that keeps native values and fixtures in one bounded runtime while preserving per-test identity and isolation controls.
workaround: The adapter invokes one explicit process per suite/entry and preserves every request and response; semantic verdicts stay native.
